title: Responsive size and type
guidance: Use a bounded shared screen-size scale, preserve explicit text enlargement, and review controls, typography, spacing and artwork together at mobile, laptop and large desktop sizes.

Desktop content leaves excessive side space on the 2560px viewport. Use intrinsic bounded fluid width consistently without fixed screen coordinates; retain readable content measures and mobile geometry.

decisions.title: Bounded viewport steps with preserved text zoom
decisions.reason: Root scale increases at1440,1920,2560 and3840 CSS pixels. Explicit150/200% text scaling multiplies that scale instead of being overwritten.

decisions.title: Narrow enlarged components recompose
decisions.reason: Dialogs give headings full width; empty states and feedback stack their icons; pagination keeps icon artwork compact and copy readable.

parameters.name: Viewport multipliers
